firstRound: Both conditions must make one query; diagnostic must use overlap or contrast, raw uses a raw read. Then finish or make one additional query.

repairScoring.patch: Exact unique-match edits to one supplied file; no coordinator changes.
repairScoring.compile: Actual candidate compilation; failures stay in denominator.
repairScoring.cutlass: All 18 frozen cases required; full FP8 observed/reference bytes independently checked, unique valid group IDs and shapes, independent beta*C for zero K, memcheck complete zero summary.
repairScoring.tmem: All 48 cases required; actual complete output against independently derived constants, native compiler hash bound; missing/aborted cases fail. Upstream CPU allocation lit separately scored.
repairScoring.resource: No claim of performance or optimal allocation; correctness success does not prove minimal repair.

limitations: Two selected public defects with prelocalized single-file repair boundaries. Not a held-out root-cause population.
Input visibility is prompt/cwd/tool-audit bounded, not proof of training-data exclusion.
Structured request/response uses the same backend as the UI; no visual agent or human outcome is measured.
Per-call time includes service/queue/network. Maximum calls and time equal; actual token use is measured, not forcibly equalized.
No diagnostic/repair feedback between independent trials. Different trial responses never enter one another.
Batched fresh CLI calls replay only within-trial visible history; no persisted model hidden reasoning state.
